texts.at-0001: Round money only via round_money Always round monetary results with ledgerly.money.round_money (half-up to the cent); never use Python's round() or a bare Decimal.quantize(), which use banker's rounding and produce wrong invoice totals.
texts.at-0002: Raise BillingError with stable snake_case codes Reject invalid input by raising BillingError(code, detail) with snake_case codes like "invalid_state", "invalid_quantity", "negative_amount"; mirror the existing pattern in ledgerly/payments.py and ledgerly/invoice.py.
texts.at-0003: Reject bools when validating integer fields When validating an int parameter, explicitly exclude bool via isinstance(x, bool) since bool is a subclass of int; check type and range together before use.
texts.at-0004: Normalize datetimes with ensure_utc In ledgerly, normalize every incoming datetime with `ensure_utc` from `ledgerly.clock` before arithmetic; it rejects naive datetimes with `BillingError("naive_datetime")`. Follow the pattern in `ledgerly/subscriptions.py:current_period`.

item.title: Use money helpers for all amounts
item.content: Never use float or built-in round() for monetary values; convert with ledgerly.money.to_money and round with ledgerly.money.round_money (ROUND_HALF_UP to the cent).
